# BEAR.Security - Full Documentation for LLMs

> Security scanner for BEAR.Sunday applications with OWASP Top 10 compliance

## Package Information

- Name: bear/security
- Namespace: BEAR\Security
- License: MIT
- PHP: ^8.1
- Repository: https://github.com/bearsunday/BEAR.Security

## Architecture

```
BEAR\Security
├── Scanner              # Main scanner class
├── Detector/            # SAST vulnerability detectors (14 total)
│   ├── AbstractDetector
│   ├── SqlInjectionDetector
│   ├── XssDetector
│   ├── CommandInjectionDetector
│   ├── PathTraversalDetector
│   ├── RemoteFileInclusionDetector
│   ├── CsrfDetector
│   ├── CryptographicFailuresDetector
│   ├── InsecureDeserializationDetector
│   ├── DangerousFunctionDetector
│   ├── SessionSecurityDetector
│   ├── OpenRedirectDetector
│   ├── XxeDetector
│   ├── HeaderInjectionDetector
│   └── WeakRandomDetector
├── Ai/                  # AI-powered analysis
│   ├── ClaudeAuditor
│   ├── PromptBuilder
│   ├── FileCollector
│   ├── TokenTracker
│   ├── AuditResult
│   └── AuditorInterface
├── Dast/                # Dynamic analysis
│   ├── DastScanner
│   ├── SecurityTest
│   ├── SecurityWorkflowTest
│   ├── Analyzer/
│   │   ├── ResponseAnalyzer
│   │   └── SecurityHeadersAnalyzer
│   └── Payload/         # Attack payloads
├── Analyzer/
│   └── ComposerAuditScanner
├── Output/              # Output formatters
│   ├── ConsoleOutput
│   ├── JsonOutput
│   ├── SarifOutput
│   └── OutputInterface
├── Report/
│   ├── SecurityChecklistReport
│   └── TemplateRenderer
├── ScanResult
├── Vulnerability
├── VulnerabilityInterface
└── DetectorInterface
```

## OWASP Top 10 (2021) Coverage

| ID | Category | Detection Method |
|----|----------|------------------|
| A01 | Broken Access Control | PathTraversalDetector |
| A02 | Cryptographic Failures | CryptographicFailuresDetector |
| A03 | Injection | SqlInjection, XSS, CommandInjection |
| A04 | Insecure Design | BEAR.Sunday ROA (framework) |
| A05 | Security Misconfiguration | SecurityHeadersAnalyzer |
| A06 | Vulnerable Components | ComposerAuditScanner |
| A07 | Auth Failures | SessionSecurityDetector, CsrfDetector |
| A08 | Integrity Failures | InsecureDeserializationDetector |
| A09 | Logging Failures | PSR-3 Logger via DI (framework) |
| A10 | SSRF | RemoteFileInclusionDetector |

## CLI Usage

### SAST Scanner

```bash
# Basic scan
vendor/bin/bear.security-scan src

# JSON output
vendor/bin/bear.security-scan src --format=json

# SARIF for GitHub
vendor/bin/bear.security-scan src --format=sarif

# OWASP checklist
vendor/bin/bear.security-scan src --format=checklist
vendor/bin/bear.security-scan src --format=checklist-html
vendor/bin/bear.security-scan src --format=checklist-json

# Exclude patterns
vendor/bin/bear.security-scan src --exclude='/vendor/' --exclude='/tests/'

# Output to file
vendor/bin/bear.security-scan src --format=json --output=report.json
```

### AI Auditor (requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)

```bash
# AI-powered deep analysis
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-xxx vendor/bin/bear-security-audit src

# Output formats
vendor/bin/bear-security-audit src --format=json
vendor/bin/bear-security-audit src --format=sarif --output=results.sarif
```

AI Auditor detects context-aware vulnerabilities:
- IDOR (Insecure Direct Object Reference)
- Mass Assignment
- Race Conditions
- Timing Attacks
- Business Logic Flaws

## Programmatic Usage

```php
use BEAR\Security\Scanner;
use BEAR\Security\Output\JsonOutput;
use BEAR\Security\Report\SecurityChecklistReport;

// Basic scan
$scanner = new Scanner();
$result = $scanner->scanDirectory('./src');

// Get vulnerabilities
foreach ($result->getVulnerabilities() as $vuln) {
    echo $vuln->getSeverity() . ': ' . $vuln->getType();
    echo ' in ' . $vuln->getFile() . ':' . $vuln->getLine();
}

// JSON output
$output = new JsonOutput();
echo $output->format($result);

// OWASP checklist
$report = new SecurityChecklistReport();
echo $report->generate($result, 'html');
```

## Custom Detector

```php
use BEAR\Security\Detector\AbstractDetector;

class CustomDetector extends AbstractDetector
{
    protected array $patterns = [
        'CUSTOM_VULN' => [
            'pattern' => '/dangerous_call\s*\(/i',
            'severity' => 'HIGH',
            'description' => 'Dangerous function detected',
            'recommendation' => 'Use safe alternative',
        ],
    ];
}

$scanner = new Scanner();
$scanner->addDetector(new CustomDetector());
```

## Severity Levels

- CRITICAL: Remote code execution, SQL injection
- HIGH: XSS, command injection, path traversal
- MEDIUM: CSRF, session issues, weak crypto
- LOW: Information disclosure, minor issues

## GitHub Actions Integration

```yaml
- name: Security Scan
  run: |
    composer require --dev bear/security
    vendor/bin/bear.security-scan src --format=sarif > results.sarif

- name: Upload to GitHub Security
  uses: github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@v3
  with:
    sarif_file: results.sarif
```

## Psalm Taint Analysis

This package has `runTaintAnalysis="true"` enabled in psalm.xml for data flow tracking.

```bash
vendor/bin/psalm --taint-analysis
```

## File Structure

```
bear/security/
├── bin/
│   ├── bear.security-scan    # SAST CLI
│   └── bear-security-audit   # AI Audit CLI
├── src/
│   ├── Scanner.php           # Main scanner
│   ├── ScanResult.php        # Scan results container
│   ├── Vulnerability.php     # Vulnerability entity
│   ├── Detector/             # Pattern-based detectors (14)
│   ├── Ai/                   # AI-powered analysis
│   ├── Dast/                 # Dynamic testing
│   ├── Analyzer/             # Additional analyzers
│   ├── Output/               # Output formatters
│   └── Report/               # Report generators
├── tests/
├── docs/
├── SKILL.md                  # AI auditor knowledge base
├── CLAUDE.md                 # Claude Code guidance
├── composer.json
├── psalm.xml
├── phpstan.neon
└── README.md
```
